cards.hint: Think about the special right angle size.
cards.quote: A right triangle is a three sided figure with one angle equal to 90 degrees.
cards.stem: What angle size defines a right triangle in this lesson?

cards.hint: Starts with s and uses opposite over hypotenuse.
cards.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.
cards.stem: What name is given to the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse?

cards.hint: Think co function for adjacent over hypotenuse.
cards.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.
cards.stem: Which ratio uses the adjacent side over the hypotenuse?

cards.hint: Opposite divided by adjacent gives this ratio.
cards.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.
cards.stem: Which ratio uses the opposite side over the adjacent side?
